1.text: Now tha word of tha LORD came 2 Jonah tha son of Amittai, sayin,
Arise, go 2 Nineveh, dat great city, N cry against it; 4 their wickedness is come up before me.

But Jonah rose up 2 flee 2 Tarshish from tha presence of tha LORD, N went down 2 Joppa; N he found a ship goin 2 Tarshish: so he paid tha fare of it, N went down in2 it, 2 go wit ’em 2 Tarshish from tha presence of tha LORD.
But tha LORD sent out a great wind in2 tha sea, N there was a mighty tempest in tha sea, so dat tha ship was like 2 be broken.

Then tha mariners were afraid, N cried every man 2 his god, N cast forth tha wares dat were in tha ship in2 tha sea, 2 lighten it of ’em. But Jonah was gone down in2 tha sides of tha ship; N he lay, N was fast asleep.
So tha shipmaster came 2 him, N said 2 him, What mean u, O sleeper? arise, call upon ur God, if so be dat God will think upon us, dat we perish not.
N dey said every one 2 his fellow, Come, N let us cast lots, dat we may know 4 whose cause dis evil is upon us. So dey cast lots, N tha lot fell upon Jonah.
Then said dey 2 him, Tell us, we pray u, 4 whose cause dis evil is upon us; What is thine occupation? N from where come u? what is ur country? N of what people r u?
N he said 2 ’em, I am an Hebrew; N I fear tha LORD, tha God of heaven, which has made tha sea N tha dry land.: or, JEHOVAH
Then were tha men exceedingly afraid, N said 2 him, Why have u done dis? 4 tha men knew dat he fled from tha presence of tha LORD, because he had told ’em.
Then said dey 2 him, What shall we do 2 u, dat tha sea may be calm 2 us? 4 tha sea wrought, N was tempestuous.
N he said 2 ’em, Take me up, N cast me forth in2 tha sea; so shall tha sea be calm 2 u: 4 I know dat 4 my sake dis great tempest is upon u.
Nevertheless tha men rowed hard 2 bring it 2 tha land; but dey could not: 4 tha sea wrought, N was tempestuous against ’em.
So dey cried 2 tha LORD, N said, We beg u, O LORD, we beg u, let us not perish 4 dis man’s life, N lay not upon us innocent blood: 4 u, O LORD, have done as it pleased u.
So dey took up Jonah, N cast him forth in2 tha sea: N tha sea ceased from her ragin.
Then tha men feared tha LORD exceedingly, N offered a sacrifice 2 tha LORD, N made vows., N vowed vows
Now tha LORD had prepared a great fish 2 swallow up Jonah. N Jonah was in tha belly of tha fish three days N three nights.

2.text: Then Jonah prayed 2 tha LORD his God out of tha fish’s belly,
N said, I cried by reason of mine affliction 2 tha LORD, N he heard me; out of tha belly of hell cried I, N u heard my voice.
4 u had cast me in2 tha deep, in tha midst of tha seas; N tha floods compassed me about: all ur billows N ur waves passed over me.
Then I said, I am cast out of ur sight; yet I will look again toward ur holy temple.
Tha waterz compassed me about, even 2 tha soul: tha depth closed me round about, tha weeds were wrapped about my head.
I went down 2 tha bottoms of tha mountains; tha earth wit her bars was about me 4 ever: yet have u brought up my life from corruption, O LORD my God.
When my soul fainted within me I remembered tha LORD: N my prayer came in 2 u, in2 thine holy temple.
Dey dat observe lyin vanities forsake their own mercy.
But I will sacrifice 2 u wit tha voice of thanksgiving; I will pay dat dat I have vowed. Salvation is of tha LORD.
N tha LORD spoke 2 tha fish, N it vomited out Jonah upon tha dry land.

3.text: N tha word of tha LORD came 2 Jonah tha second time, sayin,
Arise, go 2 Nineveh, dat great city, N preach 2 it tha preachin dat I bid u.
So Jonah arose, N went 2 Nineveh, according 2 tha word of tha LORD. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days’ journey.
N Jonah began 2 enter in2 tha city a day’s journey, N he cried, N said, Yet forty days, N Nineveh shall be overthrown.
So tha people of Nineveh believed God, N proclaimed a fast, N put on sackcloth, from tha greatest of ’em even 2 tha least of ’em.
4 word came 2 tha king of Nineveh, N he arose from his throne, N he laid his robe from him, N covered him wit sackcloth, N sat in ashes.

N he caused it 2 be proclaimed N published through Nineveh by tha decree of tha king N his nobles, sayin, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let ’em not feed, nor drink water:
But let man N beast be covered wit sackcloth, N cry mightily 2 God: yeah, let ’em turn every one from his evil way, N from tha violence dat is in their hands.
Who can tell if God will turn N repent, N turn away from his fierce anger, dat we perish not?
N God saw their works, dat dey turned from their evil way; N God repented of tha evil, dat he had said dat he would do 2 ’em; N he did it not.

4.text: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, N he was very angry.

N he prayed 2 tha LORD, N said, I pray u, O LORD, was not dis my sayin, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before 2 Tarshish: 4 I knew dat u r a gracious God, N merciful, slow 2 anger, N of great kindness, N repentest u of tha evil.
Therefore now, O LORD, take, I beg u, my life from me; 4 it is better 4 me 2 die than 2 live.
Then said tha LORD, do u well 2 be angry?
So Jonah went out of tha city, N sat on tha east side of tha city, N there made him a booth, N sat under it in tha shadow, till he might see what would become of tha city.
N tha LORD God prepared a gourd, N made it 2 come up over Jonah, dat it might be a shadow over his head, 2 deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of tha gourd.
But God prepared a worm when tha morning rose tha next day, N it struck tha gourd dat it withered.

N it happened, when tha sun did arise, dat God prepared a vehement east wind; N tha sun beat upon tha head of Jonah, dat he fainted, N wished in himself 2 die, N said, It is better 4 me 2 die than 2 live.
N God said 2 Jonah, do u well 2 be angry 4 tha gourd? N he said, I do well 2 be angry, even 2 death.
Then said tha LORD, u have had pity on tha gourd, 4 tha which u have not laboured, neither made it grow; which came up in a night, N perished in a night:
N should not I spare Nineveh, dat great city, in which r more than sixscore thousand persons dat cannot discern between their right hand N their left hand; N also much cattle?
